A.notes: A has a coherent mangrove-restoration identity: restrained palette, reed motif, and bilingual hierarchy all support the brief without melodrama. The page is clean and complete on desktop and mobile, and the measured checks are strong; motion evidence is minimal in the scroll strip, so it reads as mostly static rather than story-driving.

hard_gate_failures: Invented statistics (intermediate counter values such as 119/128 are shown instead of only 140)
